title: Identifying Liquidity

edits.reason: Intro teaches the pool sits below support: 'They sit below key support and above key resistance' and bullet 'Liquidity Pools: found below support (long stop losses + breakdown shorts)'. The chart's idx0 markPoint already names 'Stops at 83' but the support LEVEL itself is never drawn as a line. yAxis 83 sits inside band [80,108]; teal = support per palette. A markLine (level) is non-redundant with the event pins and with the liqCluster ladder (80/82/84) which represents the stops, not the support edge.

Lesson explicitly teaches buffered stop placement for this SFP short: 'add buffer to stop to survive the spike'. The swept short-stop cluster tops at 107.5 and the spike reaches 108 (wick ~110), so a buffered stop sits just above at 108.5 — inside the wick margin of band [85,108]. Pink = a stop against a short / resistance per palette. Non-redundant: no existing line marks the stop; the cluster ladder shows the swept liquidity, not the trade's stop.

notes: Verified price bands — introChart [80,108] (START 92; legs 83/80/92/108; 18 bars idx0-17), lessonChart [85,108] (START 85; legs 104/96/108r4/89; 18 bars), quiz.chart [85,108] cutIndex12 (17 bars idx0-16).
